_comment: Model-provenance debt, ratcheted. `ungated_loaders` are ml/ modules that call a model loader and reach no integrity check; `unlisted_artifacts` are committed model binaries no baseline records. Both lists may only SHRINK: scripts/model_provenance_report.py --check refuses a new entry in either. It deliberately does NOT block on the two MISMATCH artifacts — whether to regenerate the manifest, restore the bytes or investigate is an owner decision (MASTER_OUTSTANDING A7/A8), and a gate that blocked every commit until it was made would be this repository deciding it by attrition. Nor does it block on the twelve existing ungated loaders: a fail-closed check on ml/inference_engine.py would refuse a model that loads today and halt live inference. What it refuses is the THIRTEENTH. A file that leaves a list must be DELETED from it rather than left behind — an entry describing nothing is how a ratchet stops being one.
